subject: Hobgoblin Captain
picture: A medium athletic hobgoblin captain stands in a cave war room and pins a dagger into a tunnel map on a wooden table. He has small pointed ears, a broad flat nose, no tusks, and a commanding upright posture. The map is drawn as tunnel lines only, with no words and no letters. The cave has a stone ceiling, rock walls, a rack of weapons, and two tunnel openings that are closed by wooden doors so there is no blank white hole. The drawing reaches all four edges.

line_rules.shapes: large closed regions a person can color
